mission.goal: Deliver a deterministic additive BCΩ-PRIME v4 compatibility adapter over the exact v3.1 registry interface, with strict JSON validation, unchanged inherited receipts, no authority expansion, focused regression proof, and complete MODISA handoff.
mission.user: Kim Kagiso Mosiane as owner and local operator
mission.workflow: Validate one local request, delegate inherited operations unchanged to v3.1 or compile one of three v4 decision-support outputs, emit a canonical hash-bound receipt, and stop.
mission.data: Finite JSON-compatible mission observations, strategy/capability/utilization/demand signals, strategic-genome records, inherited v3.1 local state, source identities, manifests and deterministic receipts.
mission.interface: Python library with health, manifest and execute methods plus an on-demand command-line interface.
mission.stack: Python 3.12 standard library plus the exact materialized BCO-Prime v3.1 and v4 local module closure; no new third-party dependency.
mission.environment: Isolated local filesystem, one invoking process, no network, provider, scheduler, daemon, credential, deployment or recurring runtime.
mission.governance: Formation A1 local build permit, documentation-first ALLOW_CYCLE, inherited v3.1 authority controls, v4 non-sovereign truth boundary, MODISA validation and fail-closed dependency handling.
mission.failure: Typed rejection or BLOCKED_WITH_ROUTE for invalid JSON shape, unknown fields, strict scalar/range failure, non-finite numbers, authority/effect requests, unknown operations, missing exact v3.1 closure, inherited path/trust/engine holds, or receipt-integrity mismatch.
mission.testing: Syntax, 23 focused adapter unit/integration/determinism/failure/security/injected-registry-integrity tests, 20 v4 source tests, 67 sealed v3.1 tests, CLI semantic readback, MODISA proof validation and additive-file restore hash comparison.
mission.deployment: NOT_APPLICABLE: no merge, deployment, registration, provider mutation, background activation or stable promotion is authorized.
mission.continuity: Pinned main/source hashes, deterministic receipts, documentation gate packet, BUILD_CONTRACT, README, Formation specification, project memory, AI handoff and reproducible local verification commands.

assumptions.stack: Python 3.12 can import the repository-local packages used by the exact v3.1 and v4 sources.
assumptions.runtime: The caller invokes one bounded local process and supplies plain JSON-compatible inputs; no work survives process return.
assumptions.storage: The adapter adds no state root. A caller-selected local workspace is passed to the exact v3.1 registry and remains governed by v3.1 controls.
assumptions.authentication: No provider authentication exists. Source identity is bound to fresh pre-publication main ceb5cf36d1e608d0520a23114fe4bfc08eab644a and exact SHA-256 pins.
assumptions.deployment: The artifact remains local or on an isolated review branch. Merge, registration, deployment and provider activation require separate authority and readback.

components.frontend: NOT_APPLICABLE: supported surfaces are a Python API and CLI.
components.backend: BcoPrimeV4CompatibilityAdapter validates and dispatches three v4 operations or delegates every inherited operation once to v3.1 without wrapping its receipt.
components.database: NOT_APPLICABLE: the adapter creates no database; inherited v3.1 local stores remain separately governed.
components.queue: NOT_APPLICABLE: request handling is synchronous and bounded.
components.worker: The invoking Python process performs validation, delegation or pure compilation and terminates.
components.scheduler: NOT_APPLICABLE: no schedule, daemon, automation or recurring task exists.
components.cache: NOT_APPLICABLE: outputs are recomputed deterministically; no cache or freshness bypass exists.
components.storage: Caller-selected contained local workspace for the inherited registry; adapter source, tests, contract and handoff files are immutable build artifacts.
components.authentication: Exact source identity and inherited v3.1 trust controls; no credentials, tokens or provider authority are used.

architecture.state_model: REQUESTED -> VALIDATED -> DELEGATED_OR_COMPILED -> RECEIPT_RETURNED, or REJECTED / BLOCKED_WITH_ROUTE. No adapter state remains after return.
architecture.transaction_boundary: One synchronous method call. V4 operations are pure; inherited operations retain the exact v3.1 transaction, cancellation, locking and rollback boundaries.

failure_controls.INVALID_INPUT: String-keyed JSON-only normalization, explicit field allowlists, required fields, strict Boolean/integer/finite numeric validation, ranges and bounded counts.
failure_controls.AUTHORIZATION_FAILURE: Normalized truthy authority, dispatch, provider-effect, source-mutation, deployment, registration and executable-effect keys are rejected at any depth.
failure_controls.TIMEOUT: No network, retry, scheduler or unbounded loop is added; lists and counts are bounded and one call stops on the first failure.
failure_controls.PARTIAL_WRITE: V4 operations do not write. Inherited v3.1 writes are delegated unchanged to its existing atomic, lock, cancellation and hash-chain controls.
failure_controls.MISSING_CONFIGURATION: Absent exact v3.1 closure raises V31_REGISTRY_UNAVAILABLE; materialized hash mismatch raises V31_REGISTRY_INTEGRITY_MISMATCH; injected registries require the exact source-hash attestation and validated inherited surfaces.
failure_controls.EXTERNAL_API_FAILURE: NOT_APPLICABLE: the adapter has no external API or provider client; inherited optional engine absence remains an explicit v3.1 hold.

observability.correlation_ids: Mission ID, operation, input SHA-256, source main SHA and deterministic receipt SHA-256 bind each v4 request.
observability.health_checks: health reports inherited health, core invariant, v3.1/v4 operation counts, compatibility mode, source main and all zero-authority fields.
observability.structured_logs: NOT_APPLICABLE: no daemon emits logs; canonical JSON CLI output and receipts are the structured event surface.
observability.audit_logs: Each v4 execution returns a namespace, operation, input digest, output, authority flags and receipt digest; inherited receipts remain unchanged.
observability.metrics_alerts: NOT_APPLICABLE: no persistent runtime exists; tests assert counts, hashes, holds, delegation and authority boundaries.

testing.unit: Health, manifest, source bindings, operation count and self-consistent hash tests.
testing.integration: Actual v3.1 registry delegation, v4 decision compilation and strategic-genome preparation through one adapter instance.
testing.e2e_or_smoke: CLI manifest readback from a temporary workspace and exact schema/hash/authority assertions.
testing.fixtures_mocks: Deterministic plain-JSON mission, graph, metacognitive state, strategies, capabilities, utilization, demand and genome records; no provider mock.
testing.failure_first: Unknown operation, non-object payload, missing/unknown fields, non-finite number, Boolean-as-integer, authority-key request, external-effect hold and inherited path traversal.
commands: Run the sealed 67-test v3.1 unittest discovery from its original baseline root so the adjacent cff_unpacked fixture resolves.

setup_commands: Materialize the exact v3.1 and v4 repository-local dependency closure below one importable root.
Verify the pinned main and three source SHA-256 identities in docs/architecture/BCO_PRIME_V4_V31_COMPATIBILITY_ADAPTER.md.
Use Python 3.12; no package installation is required by the adapter.
deploy_commands: NOT_APPLICABLE: no deployment is authorized; an isolated branch or draft PR is review storage, not deployment.
rollback_commands: Revert or remove only the adapter, focused test, BUILD_CONTRACT and four handoff documents on the isolated branch.
Return the runtime entrypoint to the pinned v3.1 registry; no data migration or provider compensation is needed.

debugging.V31_REGISTRY_UNAVAILABLE: Materialize the exact v3.1 dependency closure with registry SHA-256 111e37d3f6d990819f5d7ce6463cf62babb13aa3cdbb20db1490ec9366211a26 or inject a conforming registry with the exact source-hash attestation; reject inherited surface/hash mismatch.
debugging.authority_or_executable_effect_rejected: Remove the authority request; external observations may be supplied only through documented external_effect fields and always remain non-authorizing.
debugging.unknown_operation: Use the manifest operation lists; inherited unknown operations intentionally fail in v3.1.
debugging.CFF_fixture_absent: Run the sealed v3.1 suite in its original layout with adjacent cff_unpacked; do not classify fixture absence as an adapter regression.
debugging.receipt_hash_mismatch: Stop, verify source identities and canonical JSON inputs, restore the additive files from a hash-matched copy, then rerun all proof commands.

formation.effectful_permit: A1-LOCAL-BUILD single-use parent Formation permit for the isolated cfbe_bco_v4_compat_build workspace only.

watchman.blocked_capability: Provider execution, dispatch, network access, credential use, source mutation at runtime, merge, deployment, registration, scheduler creation, background activation and stable self-promotion.
watchman.blocker: The v4 sources and this adapter are decision-support-only; the local A1 permit does not grant repository, provider, deployment or stable-promotion authority.
watchman.safe_substitute: Pure local v4 compilation, strategic preparation, exact v3.1 delegation, deterministic receipts, isolated review storage and explicit BLOCKED_WITH_ROUTE dependency reporting.
watchman.closure_test: Obtain a separate action-specific Formation permit, verify current source/provider state, perform one bounded effect, and independently read back the requested world-state change; this contract itself can never grant that authority.

continuity.idempotency: Canonical sorted JSON, deterministic v4 compilers, exact delegation, source pins and input/receipt SHA-256 values make repeated pure requests reproducible without duplicate effects.
continuity.checkpoints: Pinned main and component hashes, documentation gate packet, focused/v4/v3.1 test results, BUILD_CONTRACT, CLI readback, additive-file hashes and handoff documents.
continuity.resume_conditions: Fresh-read source identity, verify all pinned hashes and exact v3.1 closure, rerun documentation and Formation gates if scope changed, then rerun syntax, focused, v4, v3.1, MODISA, CLI and restore checks.
continuity.stop_switch: Terminate the invoking process or stop calling the adapter. No queue, worker, scheduler, lease, network session or recurring task remains active.

test_results: 23 of 23 focused adapter unit, integration, determinism, failure-first, security and injected-registry-integrity tests passed.
20 of 20 existing v4 institution and strategic-genome tests passed.
67 of 67 sealed v3.1 baseline tests pass in the original baseline layout with its adjacent CFF fixture closure.

Combined discovery passed 107 of 110; the three non-passing inherited CFF engine tests report only the expected absent adjacent cff_unpacked fixture in the combined layout, not an adapter behavior regression.
semantic_verification: health preserves canonical core count 100, inherits v3.1 health and adds exactly three v4 operations.
An inherited v3.1 manifest operation returns the exact same v3.1 receipt through the adapter and directly through the base registry.
V4 decision and genome outputs are deterministic, hash-bound and keep dispatch, provider-effect and stable-promotion authority false.
Authority requests, non-finite inputs, Boolean coercion, unknown fields/operations and path traversal fail closed; external-effect observations produce a hold rather than authority.
CLI manifest readback binds fresh pre-publication main ceb5cf36d1e608d0520a23114fe4bfc08eab644a and the exact component SHA-256 values.
